en.headline: Correctional officer injured after inmate assault at Pik Uk Prison
en.dek: A 23-year-old male inmate attacked a staff member outside his cell early on Sunday; the officer suffered facial injuries and both were sent to hospital, with the case referred to police.
body: A 23-year-old male inmate at Pik Uk Prison suddenly became emotionally unstable outside his cell and assaulted a correctional officer at about 7:05 a.m. on Sunday, the Correctional Services Department said.

On-site staff immediately restrained the inmate and called for support. The officer sustained facial injuries while the inmate had no visible injuries. Both were examined by the institution's doctor and then taken to a public hospital for further treatment.
The inmate had been imprisoned earlier this year after a conviction for theft. The department said the incident has been handed over to the police for investigation.

zh.headline: 壁屋監獄 23歲男囚情緒失控襲擊懲教人員 雙雙送院
zh.dek: 周日早上約7時，一名因盜竊罪服刑的23歲男囚在囚室外突然情緒失控襲擊懲教人員，職員面部受傷，兩人均送公立醫院，事件轉交警方調查。
body: 懲教署表示，周日（8日）早上約7時05分，壁屋監獄一名23歲男性在囚人士在囚室外突然情緒失控，襲擊一名懲教人員。
在場懲教人員立即制止施襲者並召喚支援人員到場。被襲懲教人員面部受傷，施襲者則無表面傷痕。兩人經院所醫生檢查後，均被送往公立醫院作進一步診治。
署方指，涉事在囚人士早前因盜竊罪被判入獄。事件已轉交警方調查。
